description: Golden request-proof vector. Pinned byte-for-byte in four places: sdk/rust-core crypto.rs and whitebox/mod.rs, and server shared/proof/proof_test.go and shared/crypto/crypto_test.go. The device and the server independently reconstruct the same preimage and HMAC, so a proof minted on-device verifies server-side without ever transmitting the per-install key.

meridian_usage.endpoint: POST /v1/payments (Meridian Pay backend, behind the kseal verify middleware)
meridian_usage.request_hash: SHA-256 over the canonical request (method, path, body) the client is about to send
meridian_usage.replay_defense: sequence is strictly monotonic per trust token; the server rejects any non-increasing sequence
